purpose: Bounded-local MULTI-BRANCH developmental substrate. Phase 3B/3C substrates could only express a single upstream per cell and collided branch identities, so no genuine fan-in was ever exercised and refusals were classifications rather than preventions. This evaluation qualifies a substrate that can form, damage, lose real output, and regenerate across branching structures it has never seen.

audited_defects_under_test.A_branch_identity_collision: v1 keyed duplicate suppression on (origin, seq) and emitted every downstream role with the same seq. REPRODUCED before the fix: a cell emitting verify_a and verify_b produced 2 distinct keys for 3 signals and the downstream cell deduped one branch away.
audited_defects_under_test.B_single_upstream: v1 stored attached_to: Optional[str]; a join is inexpressible.
audited_defects_under_test.C_refusal_not_enforced_at_commit: v1 logged a refusal, wrote Tri.HOLD, then ran development where ACTIVATE overwrote HOLD. 62 refusals proved 62 classifications, 0 preventions.
audited_defects_under_test.D_global_redundancy_scan: v1 counted siblings by scanning every cell in the tissue.
audited_defects_under_test.F_loss_never_observed_before_damage: produced_outputs was hardcoded to 0, so 'output loss' was asserted, never measured.

held_out_structures.fork_join: ingest -> (verify_a | verify_b) -> reconcile requiring BOTH -> emit
held_out_structures.asymmetric_depth_join: one arm has an extra intermediate role, so the join's two branches arrive at different ticks
held_out_structures.nested_branch: a fork whose arm itself forks, so lineage depth exceeds 2
held_out_structures.partitioned_alternative_route: Tissue2.partition() actually invoked; the blocked edge is asserted to carry zero messages, forcing a second route
held_out_structures.combined_causal_failure: partition + asymmetric starvation + capability loss in one episode

required_sequence_per_episode: execute a real payload and record a non-null OUTPUT
re-execute and record output LOSS as an observation, never as an assertion
observe deficit from the measured loss
pre_registration_method: Git ancestry. This manifest is committed ALONE, before any implementation or result file exists on this branch. scripts/ci/check_phase3d_preregistration.py proves from git history that the commit introducing this file is a strict ancestor of every commit introducing substrate/v2.py and verification/phase3d/PHASE3D_RESULTS.json, and that this file is byte-identical to its originally committed content.
